# convoy_source (Data Source)

Look up a source by `id` or by exact `name`, e.g. to retrieve its ingest URL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "convoy_source" "stripe" {
  project_id = var.incoming_project_id
  name       = "stripe"
}

output "stripe_ingest_url" {
  value = data.convoy_source.stripe.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Source ID.
- `name` (String) Exact source name. Must match exactly one source.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `mask_id` (String) Public identifier used in the ingest URL.
- `source_provider` (String) Pre-configured provider, if any.
- `type` (String) Source type.
- `url` (String) Ingest URL.
